You must be tired from fighting monsters in the\nmountains and coming down here. I'm exhausted from\nslaying monsters too. Let's take a rest!
But still, we wouldn't have noticed that you live\nin a place like this if you hadn't told us.
Yeah, you guys just didn't notice.
We weredragons have been living like this right on\nthe other side of your world for a long time...
What? Really?! According to ancient legend,\nthe weredragons appeared and went on a rampage\nthough.
That means...you guys have been coming from time\nto time to invade our world...
No, no, no, it's not like that! It's just there\nare also some weredragons that think about doing\nevil things...
The weredragons that appeared in your legend were\nthose who went to your world to commit bad deeds\nafter being ostracized in this world.
Oh, so the weredragons that appeared in the legend\nwere social outcasts in your world too.\nWe'll never know about it if you hadn't told us...
Anyway, there are a few things I'd like to ask\nyou, may I? You too right?
Oh, well, okay but...\nDepending on the question you ask, I may need to\ntell you a long story.
Why this world though?
Why do you live underground?
The battle with Coenubias
Is someone controlling this forest?
I have no questions.
[afafaf]Why this world though?
[afafaf]Why do you live underground?
[afafaf]The battle with Coenubias
[afafaf]Is someone controlling this forest?
According to legend, when the land of the original\nworld fell apart due to the Cataclysm,\nmost weredragons were thrown out and drifting in
another dimension. Just when they thought that\nthey were gonna die, this moving forest which they\nhappened to pass by saved them...
Whoa...the Cataclysm had caused unexpected damages\nand casualties...The gods were prolly too busy and\ndidn't have enough time to handle the weredragons?
Just like the people of Akaku and these\nweredragons, maybe there are still many people\nthat are stranded in another world...
Our ancestors said that the Eumanos were already\nliving in the forest under the protection of a big\nsacred tree ruling it by the time they got here.
Our ancestors had agreed to live separately from\nthe Eumanos and the forest creatures. So the world\nof the weredragons was created under the forest...
I see. So they live on the surface and you guys\nlive underground. That's probably the best way to\navoid conflicts...
I heard Coenubias came here not long after our\nancestors lived under this forest.
The huge sacred tree that was protecting the\nforest set the Eumanos and the forest creatures\ndown on Toram's ground.
Our ancestors were told to stay underground and\nthe sacred tree used all of its power to get rid\nof the Coenubias...
How was the sacred tree then?
How did the Eumanos get back here?
[afafaf]How was the sacred tree then?
[afafaf]How did the Eumanos get back here?
What happened to the sacred tree that had used up\nall of its power?
I heard it withered and vanished...
What?! So, the mysterious power and all the\nknowledge it had were gone?!
Normally yeah, but after dropping the Eumanos,\nthe sacred tree transferred some of its power and\nknowledge into a seed and left it with them.
And you know what, your leader was born from that\nseed.
Reallyyy?
I see, that's why she's so knowledgeable and\nstrangely calm...
I heard from our leader that it was an epic\nbattle...But how did the Eumanos manage to return\nto this forest again after leaving it?
Oh, when our ancestors became able to freely move\nthe forest,
They found out that the forest the Eumanos created\non Toram was attacked by Coenubias, so they\nrescued and brought the Eumanos to this forest.
Then a boundary agreement was made once again\nbetween your leader and our ancestors.
Really?! Our leader has never said anything about\nthat...
Oh, a new rule was added to the agreement. We were\ntold not to make contact with you all until you\ngot used to everything here.
Your leader didn't tell you anything about us, did\nshe?
I see...That's why she said there was nothing to\nworry about...
Well, your role is to protect the creatures living\nin the forest which is different from the\nweredragons' role that is to move the forest.
I guess your leader thinks that it's better if we\ndon't stick our nose into each other's business.
Well, since you guys came here to see us like\nthis, she probably thinks that it's time for us\nto meet.
Yeah. The huge sacred tree that was protecting\nthis forest used to decide where and how it moved.
However, since it had used up its power to fight\nthe Coenubias and disappeared, the forest was left\nuncontrolled for some time.
Wow...Isn't that a big problem?
Because the sacred tree was gone, the plants and\nflowers died and this forest became a massive\nchunk of rock that was drifting in the sky of
Toram for some time with our ancestors as its\npassengers.
Then there was this great scientist weredragon\namong our ancestors who figured out a way to move\nthe forest freely...
That mean...now you guys are controlling this\nforest?
Right. Oh, but that doesn't mean we can just move\nit as we like. The one that is moving it is\ndriving it carefully so that it won't harm
the Eumanos and the forest creatures, as well as\nnot to get noticed by Coenubias.
In this case, "driving carefully" doesn't sound\nquite right...
Whew...So many things had happened in this forest\nalone...By the way Zianga, why did you come to the\nsurface?
It's because Coenubias seem to have invaded not\nonly the forest, but also the underground...
I was chasing the Coenubias and as I went up to\nthe surface, I found myself surrounded so many of\nthem. It was horrible.
After listening to your stories, now we know that\nyou guys are controlling the movement of the\nforest. We'll help you get rid of Coenubias too!
I wish I could act cool and say we can handle it,\nbut...the underground is too big for just us to\nhandle. Honestly, I'm glad you wanna help, thanks!
Yeah, yeah, it's beautiful to see you guys get\nalong...But, remember, don't do anything stupid,\nokay?
Because it's our responsibility to return you\nsafe and sound to the leader.
Understood!!
Well then, let's just go to our town first to plan\na strategy to defeat Coenubias! C'mon!
What the?!\nI thought we've got rid of them...
It looks like there are places other than the\ncrater that allow them to get in...We'll just have\nto beat them and keep pushing forward for now!!
